correctness.rationale: Exact coefficient comparison proves the claim. Under D1=0, D-E=J^2/3 and p'(u)=3(u-J/3)^2. The printed Delta2 becomes (J^3+27(N-A))^2, so Delta2<0 is impossible and Delta2=0 is exactly N-A=-J^3/27. Substitution factors p(u) as (u-J/3)^3. The bundled symbolic replay verifies these identities without numerical approximation.

value.rationale: The result fixes the boundary at which the unresolved Case-3 equilibrium cubic collapses to a triple positive root. This boundary is the natural organizing center for equilibrium continuation in that regime. The correction also prevents an empty discriminant case and a spurious Q-dependence from entering future bifurcation calculations; it is therefore more than a cosmetic typo check.
